title: Assorted Wall Accessorie Swing Arm Double Towel Rail 12.5-Inch Solid Brass Wall Mount | Allied Brass
short_title: Assorted Wall Accessorie Swing Arm Double Towel Rail 12.5-Inch
description:
Upgrade towel storage in your bathroom with a wall mount, swing arm double towel rail crafted from solid brass for enduring use.

Highlights:
- Double swing-arm design: two arms swivel independently to keep towels accessible and fold close to the wall when not in use
- Wall-mounted installation helps save floor space and keeps your bathroom organized
- Solid brass construction
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean look and easier installation
- Part of the Waverly Place collection for coordinating with matching bathroom accessories

Specs:
- Category: Assorted Wall Accessories
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Material: Brass
- Overall size: 12.5 in L x 7 in W x 7.1 in H
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Included: Towel rail and all installation hardware
- Finish options: available in multiple designer finishes
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
